noise_model.definition: sigma = noise standard deviation / clean offline channel standard deviation (population std, global x/y/speed/unwrapped yaw); same fixed physical std offline and online

noise_description: Independent additive zero-mean Gaussian output noise, identical standard deviations to online measurements. Added once per sample in global x/y/speed/yaw coordinates before alignment, clustering and overlapping window extraction. Commanded inputs and true states unchanged.
